name: Sakimori Motoko
source:
Direct and quiet, Motoko Sakimori is a second-year student who doubles as the local Shinto shrine maiden. She is recognized for donning her robes in place of a school uniform, serious, tough-love attitude, nage-waza martial arts and purple hair. In a fashion similar to [url=/c1756]Sora[/url], Motoko opens up around [url=/c1831]Yoshijirou[/url], showing a less seen, tender side of her; one including an affection for anything cute.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors]Wikipedia[/url].]
